notes.title: Hotfix 1.01
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where if you died during the Taco stand scene, you would get teleported back to the beggining of that scene. Now you just got to speak with the latest person you encounter.

Tip: Hold CTRL to crouch (there's a table nearby) ;)
